meaningful_changes.claim: Hot PPI and strong retail sales coincided with a sharp Treasury rally and wider HY OAS, favoring growth/credit-tail interpretation over simple reflation.
SOXX fell despite TSMC strong results and guidance, indicating valuation/crowding deleveraging; delayed good-news reaction remains the main competing explanation.
China large-cap defense and small-cap deleveraging were confirmed by index dispersion, broad market weakness and much higher MO volatility repricing.
Gold rebound is fully consistent with falling real yields and a weaker dollar, so policy-credit attribution remains unproven.
AG downside follow-through lost attractiveness after the sharp day selloff and night rebound; prior short condition is cancelled.
